podcast.title: Early Influences and Move to California
podcast.body: Donita Sparks grew up in Chicago, where she was a fan of bands like The Ramones, The Beach Boys, and The B-52s. Her deep fascination with surf music ultimately led her to move to California at the age of 19. "Danita grew up in Chicago as a fan of both the Ramones and the Beach Boys. She was partial to the B-52s, too. And it was a fascination with surf music that eventually drew her out to California when she was 19."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Songwriting Contribution
podcast.body: Donita Sparks wrote the song "Pretend We're Dead." "She also wrote that song."
